description: #3830 — READ-command differential over `get_reminder_settings`, waived as "device-local reminder preferences in `app_settings`, outside the conformance snapshot scope" until a fixture could put the same rows on both stacks; `seed.app_settings` is that, `(key, value)` pairs inserted verbatim into the backend `app_settings` table and the mock's map. `reminders::get_settings` reads two keys: `reminders.enabled` is on iff the stored value is the string `'1'`, and `reminders.time` is served as stored. Seeded on, at `07:30` — neither is the default, so a mock answering a hard-coded `ReminderSettings::default()` fails on both attributes; the defaults themselves are pinned by `query_reminder_settings_defaults.json`, which seeds no `app_settings` at all. The answer is a bare struct with no id, so it projects to ONE token under the fixed head `reminder_settings`. NOT pinned: `set_reminder_settings` (still waived — a device-local writer outside the snapshot).
name: query_reminder_settings

queries.comment: Both keys seeded away from the defaults: `enabled` is the boolean `true` because the stored value is `'1'`, and `time` is `07:30` as stored. The defaults (`false` / `09:00`) fail on both attributes.
queries.name: reminder_settings_seeded_on
